title: repro replay adds a second KB-Work trailer to a replayed backlog-planning commit, which the push gate refuses
goal: repro replay leaves a replayed commit that changes only backlog item files with the KB-Work trailer it already carries (the items it files) and adds KB-Work: ITEM only to the other commits, so kbgit.py check-trailers passes on the replayed range; a planted instance with such a commit proves it. In SP-bhzxxhub the orchestrator rewrote 7 replayed commits by hand. Found by the SP-bhzxxhub review (S3).

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,os.path.abspath('_tools'))
import bench_repro as b
t=tempfile.mkdtemp();g=lambda c,*a:s.run(['git','-C',c,'-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','-c','core.hooksPath=/dev/null',*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
w=t+'/w';os.makedirs(w+'/kb/_self/backlog');g(w,'init','-q','-b','main');open(w+'/a','w').write('a');g(w,'add','-A');g(w,'commit','-qm','start')
rev=g(w,'rev-parse','HEAD').strip();g(t,'clone','-q','--bare',w,t+'/o.git');c=t+'/c';g(t,'clone','-q',t+'/o.git',c)
os.makedirs(c+'/kb/_self/backlog',exist_ok=True);open(c+'/kb/_self/backlog/ST-x.json','w').write('{}')
g(c,'add','-A');g(c,'commit','-qm','chore(backlog): file ST-x\n\nKB-Work: ST-x');g(c,'push','-q','origin','main')
json.dump({'rev':rev,'instances':[{'n':1,'bare':t+'/o.git'}]},open(t+'/'+b.MANIFEST,'w'))
os.chdir(w);b.replay(1,'ST-y',root=t,out=lambda *a:None)
msg=g(w,'log','-1','--format=%B');n=msg.count('KB-Work:');print(repr(msg));sys.exit(0 if n==1 and 'ST-y' not in msg else 1)
